message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation** on Yahoo Finance (and most other major stock exchanges).  
On Yahoo Finance, you can view its page here:  

[https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT)

The page includes:

- Current stock price and performance charts  
- Company overview and key statistics  
- Financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow)  
- Analyst estimates and ratings  
- News and recent events related to Microsoft

If you need more specific data (e.g., latest price, market cap, P/E ratio), let me know!
